description_expanded: Overview5.0(4 reviews)Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Luxury Beach Home!* Private Heated Pool and Spacious Outdoor Patio* Elevator Access* Pet Friendly (add'l $250 fee, 1 pet under 15lbs)* 3–4 Minute Walk to the Beach – Access at the Lupine Beach. * Neighborhood Beach Walkover-Please Note: Beach access is via the Lupine Beach Neighborhood Beach Walkover, the walkover includes stairs and is not handicap accessible.* Less than a mile to Rosemary Beach – Convenient access to upscale dining, boutique shopping, and entertainment* Adjacent to Camp Helen State Park – Enjoy beautiful natural surroundings and a peaceful coastal setting* Close to 30A Dining and Attractions – Easy access to restaurants, shops, beaches, and local activities* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Blue Fin, an exquisite luxury retreat designed for relaxation, privacy, and unforgettable coastal memories! This impressive 8-bedroom, 8.5-bathroom home comfortably accommodates up to 26 guests and is located at the end of a quiet road in beautiful Inlet Beach. Step outside and enjoy your own private oasis featuring a heated pool and spacious outdoor patio. Blue Fin features high-end finishes, Smart TVs, WiFi, an elevator, and a chef's kitchen equipped with top-tier appliances. The spacious layout provides multiple areas for everyone to gather while still offering plenty of space. Sleeping arrangements are designed for large groups, with six King bedrooms, a third-floor bedroom featuring two King beds and two Queen beds, and a fourth-floor bedroom with two Queen beds. Additional sleeping space is available with sleeper sofas in the first-floor game room and top-floor living room. Whether you're relaxing by the private heated pool, exploring Rosemary Beach, spending the day at the Gulf, or gathering together for a family meal, Blue Fin offers an exceptional setting for your next luxury 30A getaway.*The neighborhood is growing, and construction may be taking place nearby, including in front of the home. Construction is outside of our control, and we want to be upfront so there are no surprises during your stay. We appreciate your understanding as this beautiful area continues to develop.**Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, pool/spa heater controls, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door and pool area.*The Bed Setup:1st Floor:Game Room: Sleeper Sofa2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom: King Bed 3rd Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen-over-Queen Bunk BedsGuest Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom: King Bed4th Floor:Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds Living Room: Sleeper SofaArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
